chrome_hint: eBay AU sold+completed: 'Plumb USA axe', 'Plumb felling axe vintage', 'Plumb 3.5 lb axe handle'; also eBay.com US sold (Terapeak) 'Plumb Fayetteville axe', 'Plumb USA single bit axe'. Compare cleaned heads with handles in similar condition; Australian Hytest/Plumb Australia axes are a separate, dearer line. Also check Gumtree and Facebook Marketplace asking prices for vintage Plumb axes.
viewing_check: Check the head weight stamp (e.g. 3 1/2 lb), any extra marks (Fayetteville, Philadelphia, Hytest, Australia), poll cracks, eye damage or handle wedge condition, and whether the bit is chipped or re-ground.
